title: Jim Marrs' sphere moves under its own power

tellings.quote: we went to his home and saw this sphere

plain: A metal sphere kept at the Texas home of the late writer Jim Marrs is said to move on its own, with no visible push. The journalist Ross Coulthart says he saw it himself in 2021: "we went to his home and saw this sphere." He also names a man called Patrick Jackson in the story. If it is true, the sphere would be an object driven by some power no one can explain.
